==Description==
'''Excavation Point''' is an underground [[Maps|map]] that takes place in an energy crystal cave. It is a map exclusive to [[Story Mode|Story]] mode.

==Design & Path==
'''Excavation Point''' is a large brown cave with many green energy crystals. These crystals can be seen in many crates as this is the main resource mined in the cave. Across the cave, there are many crates, containers and rocks scattered around the place. There are also two excavators there. In the middle, there is an orange container which has lava on the inside. On the walls of the cave there are a few man made walls, spotlights and a few metal platforms. At the top there is a small hole showing the sky.

The path starts and ends at a gate with a red light. It first goes straight, turning once it reaches the few crates. Shortly later it takes another turn and reaches the center, where it goes around the container in the middle. After doing a circle around it, it goes straight, turns around once it reaches the blue container and finally makes the last turn to enter the gate.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Excavation Point}}

==Strategy==
*Either the start of the path which covers both the beginning and the end of the path or the circle in the middle are the best spots on this map.

==Trivia==
*Originally, '''Excavation Point''' had a different path layout which can still be seen in its icon and in the [[Story Mode|Story]] mode chapter one trailer, though it ended up being replaced by the one seen in-game.
**While most of the path was removed, there is one remaining part of it above one of the holes with the crystals. As the path it was connected to was removed, there is now a random piece of path completely disconnected from the rest of the path.
